metadata.purpose: Group B: edit-instruction style prompts for LongCat comparison
metadata.notes: Group A (compare_5_captions.json) uses scene+aesthetic description. Group B (this file) uses direct edit instructions. Compare output differences on same 5 source images.

samples.new_caption: Blur the cluttered building background into soft bokeh to emphasize the smartphone screen.
samples.aesthetic_target: blur background, emphasize phone screen subject

samples.new_caption: Apply warm golden-hour lighting across the mountains and sky, keep the prayer flags vivid.
samples.aesthetic_target: warm golden hour lighting, balanced composition

samples.new_caption: Add warm afternoon sunlight highlighting the branches, increase contrast, keep vivid natural colors (do not convert to black-and-white).
samples.aesthetic_target: warm light, contrast enhancement, keep color

samples.new_caption: Increase contrast between sky and water, deepen blacks and brighten highlights, keep the black-and-white look.
samples.aesthetic_target: increase contrast, balance composition, preserve B&W

samples.new_caption: Add dramatic side-lighting with strong shadows, fill the empty right side with subtle texture, keep the black-and-white style.
samples.aesthetic_target: dramatic lighting, depth, fill empty space subtly
